metadata.creator: Roger Johnson
metadata.description:
This episode features Roger Johnson standing in for Dave Pearce, as opposed to just serving up an RJ Scratch Attack. He's mixing and cutting up Hip-Hop from Rakim, Davy D, Daddy Freddy, Roxanne Shante and Mr. X & Mr. Z. You'll also hear tracks by Mr Lee, Liz Torres, Shalamar, Well Red and 52nd Street.

- IrishCraig - RandomRapRadio
